title: Teddy Bear Baby Bodysuit, Light Blue Baby Boy Outfit, Bears and Clouds Long Sleeve, Baby Shower Gift, New Baby Gift
description:
Little teddy bears, some waving and some fast asleep on fluffy clouds, scattered with tiny stars on a soft light blue bodysuit. A tender, timeless print for the first months.

A lovely baby shower or new baby gift, perfect for everyday cuddles and first photos.

DETAILS
- 100% combed ring-spun cotton (solid colour), soft and breathable
- Long sleeves, lap shoulders for easy dressing
- Plastic snaps at the crotch for quick changes
- Sizes: Newborn (0-3M), 6M, 12M, 18M
- Colour: Light Blue, small motifs printed across the front

CARE
Machine wash cold, inside out. Do not tumble dry on high heat. Do not iron directly on the print.

PRODUCTION AND SHIPPING
Printed on demand by our production partner in the USA and shipped with tracking. Production takes 2-5 business days. This item ships to the USA and Canada.

Design created by MurettoStudio with the help of AI image tools, then checked and prepared for print by me.

Photos: the first photo is the product mockup from our print partner; the lifestyle photos are digital mockups created for illustration.
